findings.description: Credential-bearing origins and non-production identity were not pinned.
findings.resolution: Require approval-protected exact target identity, origins, expected revisions, production aliases, HTTPS, no redirects, and exact browser API destination before credentials or mutation.

findings.description: The frontend configured-source scenario had no implementation or write scope.
findings.resolution: Add typed frontend configured-source discovery, actual ingestion-surface invocation, focused tests, locks, and scopes.

findings.description: The workflow uploaded evidence before validation.
findings.resolution: Validate before upload and replace invalid runner output with a separately generated and validated minimal failure envelope.

findings.description: The evidence schema could not represent failures before surface observation.
findings.resolution: Allow null safe observations only for failed evidence with corresponding stable failure codes; require complete observations for passing evidence.

findings.description: Promotion revision identity permitted mutable labels without provenance.
findings.resolution: Use immutable full commit SHAs with allowlisted provenance; for detached Railway CLI uploads generate a canonical build stamp only after verifying clean HEAD equals the requested SHA, correlate its digest to the SHA-bearing Railway message, and prohibit runtime promotion relabeling.

findings.description: The retired-route policy was undefined and downward-configurable.
findings.resolution: Add a non-overridable checked-in baseline containing both retired production mutation routes; runtime may only add entries.

findings.description: Asset completeness and resource bounds were undefined.
findings.resolution: Emit a revision/digest-bound Vite asset manifest and enforce completeness, redirect, MIME, per-asset, cumulative, count, and deadline limits.

findings.description: Browser and schema-validator dependency ownership was implicit.
findings.resolution: Add a dedicated release-smoke Python extra pinning Playwright and JSON Schema format support; install Chromium explicitly in release CI.

findings.description: The mutation fixture alternated between a data file and executable command.
findings.resolution: Use only bounded schema-validated JSON beneath a checked-in allowlisted root; reject absolute, traversal, and symlink paths and prohibit shell execution.

findings.description: Ambiguous-submit reconciliation had no retained correlation.
findings.resolution: Derive the idempotency key deterministically as aca-release-smoke-v1:<run_id> so operators can reconstruct it from sanitized evidence.

findings.description: The frontend-changing read-only package did not verify its focused frontend contract, types, or build.
findings.resolution: Run the focused frontend workflow-contract test, TypeScript typecheck, and production build within wp-readonly-runner and repeat them at integration.
